items.question: Is CS 7650 offered in Fall 2026? List its sections, instructors, and meeting times.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Fall 2026 has sections O01, A, and O3. Section A is taught by Kartik Goyal on Monday and Wednesday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM. O01 and O3 are taught by Mark Riedl and have TBA meeting times.

items.question: Who teaches CS 7641 in Fall 2026, and when do its sections meet?
items.gold_answer: Fall 2026 has sections A, O01, O3, R2, and B. Max Roozbahani teaches A on Tuesday and Thursday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM and B from 12:30 PM to 1:45 PM. Theodore LaGrow teaches O01, O3, and R2, whose meeting times are TBA.

items.question: What Fall 2026 sections, instructors, and meeting times are offered for CSE 6242?
items.gold_answer: Fall 2026 has sections A, O01, and OAN. Duenhorng Chau teaches A on Tuesday and Thursday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM. O01 and OAN list Duenhorng Chau and Max Roozbahani with TBA meeting times.

items.question: When and where does CS 7652 meet in Fall 2026, and who teaches it?
items.gold_answer: CS 7652 section A is taught by Alan Ritter on Monday and Wednesday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM in Mason 3133.

items.question: What are the Fall 2026 CS 4400 sections, instructor, locations, and meeting times?
items.gold_answer: Melinda McDaniel teaches both Fall 2026 sections. Section B meets Wednesday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM in Clough 144, and section A meets Monday from 3:30 PM to 4:45 PM in Howey Physics L1.
